title: Female borrowers who mention specific agricultural inputs like certified seeds and fertilizers may fund faster.
Female borrowers who use descriptive framing of their institutional affiliation or status may fund more slowly.
Female borrowers who express explicit gratitude to Kiva or their partner organization may fund faster.
Female borrowers mentioning a spouse's income for repayment may fund faster.
Female borrowers who mention loan cycle history and specific financial figures may fund faster.
Male borrowers who include specific financial figures for monthly income and loan cycle numbers may fund faster.
Female borrowers who use character-based adjectives like 'hardworking' or 'resilient' may fund more slowly.
Female borrowers who provide highly specific details about the loan's intended use may fund faster.
Female borrowers who provide specific numbers for their own age or their children's ages may fund faster.
Female borrowers who express explicit gratitude to lenders may fund more slowly.
Female borrowers who mention the goal of building savings fund faster.
Higher verbosity and excessive personal detail predict slower funding regardless of gender.
Pitches that include specific monthly income figures predict slower funding regardless of gender.
Female borrowers who emphasize that their business is currently doing well or is being sustained fund faster.
Mentioning specific asset or business ownership predicts faster funding regardless of gender.
Borrowers who explicitly name their institutional partner fund faster regardless of gender.
Female borrowers who mention family members or household responsibilities fund more slowly.
Mentioning the loan amount in local currency predicts faster funding regardless of gender.
